response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT fundflux, spatial_count, SUM(spatial_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(spatial_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT fundflux, spatial_count, spatial_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share, spatial_count - average_count AS exceeds_average FROM totals WHERE spatial_count > average_count;

assumptions.assumption: NULL fundflux values form one funding-source group, as SQLite GROUP BY does.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude projects with no recorded funding source from the counts, total, and average.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT fundflux, spatial_count, SUM(spatial_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(spatial_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT fundflux, spatial_count, spatial_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share, spatial_count - average_count AS exceeds_average FROM totals WHERE spatial_count > average_count;
